Comment.value: Blackguard initiation reagent (roadmap: blackguard-quest). Branded by the torture-rack in the Keep of Barad-Dur (q_bkg_altar OnUsed, instance tag BkgFallAltar) only when the fallen PC swears the Black Oath bleeding (QBKG_ComesBleeding in q_bkg_inc -- GetCurrentHitPoints < GetMaxHitPoints). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_bkg_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_bkg_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it. BaseItem 24 + ModelPart1 44 copied from the module's existing Oath-Light of the West (q_dvc_light) / Notch of the Proven Blade (q_wpm_notch).

value.0: A short bar of iron burned black, still cold no matter how long it is held, marked with a brand the torture-racks of Barad-Dur press into whatever is laid on them. It came away in your hand when you swore the Black Oath with your own blood on the iron -- the moment something in you turned and did not turn back. It is proof of the fall, and it means nothing to anyone but Halmir the Grey, who keeps the Blackguards' page and writes the fallen down by name.
